title: Dozens of people killed in assault on village in Nigeria’s Borno State
summary: Resident of Darul Jama says military was warned for three days about Boko Haram massing near village but did nothing.

title: Portugal remembers Jota as Ronaldo leads way in World Cup win in Armenia
